analysisDiffHash.input: Raw unified-diff bytes for the listed analysis-summary implementation and coverage files relative to threadnoteBaseCommit. The shared worktree contained other agents' changes outside this path set; they are intentionally not represented by this digest.

method.backfillCommand: bun -e 'import { Effect } from "effect"; import { CodeGraphStore } from "<threadnote-worktree>/src/code_graph/store.ts"; import { ApplicationLayer } from "<threadnote-worktree>/src/effect/runtime.ts"; const databasePath = "<graph-database>"; const snapshotId = "cgsn_7ccb83f2c25ccb4336ef40e69634f54c23c88383"; const program = Effect.gen(function*(){ const store = yield* CodeGraphStore; yield* store.initialize(databasePath); const started = performance.now(); const backfilled = yield* store.ensureAnalysisSummary(databasePath, snapshotId); const summary = yield* store.loadAnalysisSummary(databasePath, snapshotId); return {backfilled, milliseconds: Math.round(performance.now()-started), summary}; }); Effect.runPromise(program.pipe(Effect.provide(ApplicationLayer))).then(value => console.log(JSON.stringify(value))).catch(error => { console.error(error); process.exitCode = 1; });'
method.ensureAndReadCommand: /usr/bin/time -p bun -e 'import { Effect, Option } from "effect"; import { CodeGraphStore } from "<threadnote-worktree>/src/code_graph/store.ts"; import { ApplicationLayer } from "<threadnote-worktree>/src/effect/runtime.ts"; const databasePath = "<graph-database>"; const snapshotId = "cgsn_7ccb83f2c25ccb4336ef40e69634f54c23c88383"; const value = await Effect.runPromise(Effect.gen(function*(){ const store = yield* CodeGraphStore; const started = performance.now(); const backfilled = yield* store.ensureAnalysisSummary(databasePath, snapshotId); const summary = Option.getOrThrow(yield* store.loadAnalysisSummary(databasePath, snapshotId)); return {backfilled, milliseconds: performance.now()-started, symbolGroups: summary.symbols.length, edgeGroups: summary.edges.length, symbolCount: summary.symbolCount, edgeCount: summary.edgeCount}; }).pipe(Effect.provide(ApplicationLayer))); console.log(JSON.stringify(value));'
method.pathPolicy: Every machine-local path is replaced with a reviewed placeholder. The repository, commit, aggregate counts, and snapshot identity describe a public fixture.
method.storageCommand: stat -f '{"databaseBytes":%z}' <graph-database>; sqlite3 <graph-database> "select page_count from pragma_page_count; select page_size from pragma_page_size; select freelist_count from pragma_freelist_count; select count(*) from snapshot_analysis_summary_receipts; select count(*) from snapshot_analysis_symbol_counts; select count(*) from snapshot_analysis_edge_histogram; select count(*) from snapshot_analysis_edge_counts; select count(*) from building_analysis_batches;"

caveats: The Threadnote implementation was measured from a dirty, shared candidate worktree, not an immutable released commit. The scoped analysis diff digest makes the relevant source bytes reviewable but does not claim provenance for unrelated dirty paths.
The IntelliJ fixture itself was clean at the recorded public commit, and the JSON stats response reported that exact commit and ready snapshot.

The 48.0 second and 52.6 second legacy observations were recorded during the interactive audit but their raw /usr/bin/time stdout was not retained as a separate artifact. They are preserved only at the precision originally recorded.
The first backfill completed in approximately 20 seconds. Its exact elapsed output was not retained, so this artifact deliberately does not report sub-second precision for that observation.
The complete CLI wall time includes exact current-Git observation and process startup; result.usage.durationMilliseconds isolates the in-process analysis read.
provenance.legacyTimingSource: Interactive 2026-08-01 IntelliJ whole-graph analysis audit run log, summarized before the persisted-summary backfill. The two recorded variants used aggregate page sizes of 50,000 and 250,000.
provenance.storageBeforeSource: code-graph-intellij-query-2026-08-01.json in this directory, captured from the same database and snapshot before summary tables were materialized.

oneTimeLegacyBackfill.precision: Approximate whole-second observation; exact timing stdout was not retained.

notes: The durable delta is exactly 11 SQLite pages at 4,096 bytes each.
The WAL was empty at capture. The 32 KiB shared-memory sidecar is transient SQLite coordination state and is excluded from the durable database delta.
No building_analysis_batches receipts remained after the ready snapshot completed.

artifact.invariantsCommand: bun -e "const p='test/evaluation/candidates/threadnote-4.0.0/benchmarks/darwin-arm64-m1-max/code-graph-intellij-analysis-summary-2026-08-01.json'; const x=await Bun.file(p).json(); if(x.storage.after.databaseBytes-x.storage.before.databaseBytes!==x.storage.durableDatabaseByteDelta) throw new Error('byte delta'); if((x.storage.after.databasePageCount-x.storage.before.databasePageCount)*x.fixture.databasePageSize!==x.storage.durableDatabaseByteDelta) throw new Error('page delta'); if(x.results.persistedEnsureAndRead.symbolCount!==x.fixture.symbolCount||x.results.persistedEnsureAndRead.edgeCount!==x.fixture.edgeCount) throw new Error('counts');"
